# Chile, Bolivia and Peru in 12 Days

**Dates:** 31 October to 11 November 2026. **Duration:** 12 days / 11 nights.

Start in Santiago, then travel via Calama to the Atacama Desert. After acclimatising in San Pedro, cross into Bolivia for two days by jeep exploring colourful lagoons, geysers and the Uyuni Salt Flat. From La Paz, travel via Tiwanaku to Puno, the Uros reed islands and Cusco. Finish the trip with Machu Picchu, Inca sites and time to get to know Lima.

Domestic flights are included. From Puno to Cusco, you'll travel on a tourist bus with sightseeing stops. You'll visit Machu Picchu with an English-speaking group.
